ownership.quote: Morph Cloud - Infrastructure for AI agents with instant environment branching and burst scalability. ... Organization: Morph Labs

stage.quote: In September 2024, Morph Labs raised $5.75 million in seed funding led by Khosla Ventures to accelerate development of infrastructure for AI software engineering agents and neurosymbolic reasoning systems.
stage.note: A Y Combinator company named 'Morph' (batch S23, one-liner 'Fast Models Optimized for Coding Agents') exists at ycombinator.com/companies/morph, but its website is morphllm.com (AutoInfra, Inc., founder Tejas Bhakta) — a different, unrelated company from the 'morph.so' / 'Morph Labs' (CEO Jesse Han) behind Morph Cloud. Rejected as a hint match. Separately, a third same-named entity, Morph (Ethereum L2), raised a $19M seed from Dragonfly in 2024 — also unrelated. Tracxn reportedly lists Morph Labs as unfunded/funding-redacted, which conflicts with the $5.75M seed figure; treat that figure as credible-but-not-independently-verified by this research pass.

total_funding_usd.basis: Grokipedia (citing a Morph Labs blog post titled '9.16.24 Announcing our 5.75M seed fundraise') and a Google AI Overview citing Dealroom both put the seed at $5.75M in Sept 2024; the blog post itself now 404/410s and rl-list.com's vendor profile says Tracxn lists Morph Labs as unfunded with only an undisclosed Szegedy angel/seed reported, so this is not independently confirmed from a live primary source in this pass.

last_round.quote: In September 2024, Morph Labs raised $5.75 million in seed funding led by Khosla Ventures to accelerate development of infrastructure for AI software engineering agents and neurosymbolic reasoning systems.

note: Morph Labs (morph.so / cloud.morph.so) is a San Francisco AI infra/research lab founded 2023 by CEO Jesse Han, building 'Morph Cloud' (Infinibranch/Liquid Metal snapshot-branch-restore VM compute for AI agents) and a 'verified superintelligence' research program led by Chief Scientist Christian Szegedy (ex-xAI co-founder, inventor of batch normalization), who joined in 2025 and was reportedly also an early seed/angel investor. CB Insights lists Morph Labs' latest round type as 'Other Investors' with investors Betaworks, Roar Venture, and a16z Bio + Health — consistent with, but not a full confirmation of, the $5.75M September 2024 seed reported elsewhere. Be careful of name collisions: (1) Morph / morphllm.com (YC S23, AutoInfra Inc., Tejas Bhakta) is a different company; (2) Morph (Ethereum L2) which raised $19M from Dragonfly is unrelated; (3) a student neurotech startup also called 'Morph Labs' (brain-controlled prosthetics, Pranai Reddy/Nick Cadavid) is unrelated.
